## Overview

This document simulates embryo development and transfer, models PGT-A use, and estimates the association between PGT-A and live birth after the first transfer using inverse probability of treatment weighting (IPTW).

The simulation functions are sourced from the `R/` directory.

## Setup

```{r}
#| code-fold: true
library(data.table)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggsci)
library(WeightIt)
library(cobalt)
library(survey)
library(crosstable)
library(patchwork)

r_files <- list.files("R", pattern = "\\.[Rr]$", full.names = TRUE)
for (file in r_files) source(file)
```

## Simulation assumptions

```{r}
PGT_SENS <- 0.98
PGT_SPEC <- 0.92
n <- 5000
```

## Modelling PGT-A use

The probability of PGT-A use increases with age, number of eggs, AMH, and the number of embryos reaching day 3 and day 5.

```{r}
f_do_pgt_prob1 <- function(
  x,
  intercept = qlogis(0.01),
  age_log_odds_per_year = 0.46,
  eggs_log_odds_per_log_increase = 0.15,
  amh_log_odds_per_log_increase = 0.20,
  day1_log_odds_per_log_increase = 0.10,
  day3_log_odds_per_log_increase = 0.70,
  day5_log_odds_per_log_increase = 2.00
) {
  log_odds <- intercept +
    age_log_odds_per_year * (x$age - 35) +
    eggs_log_odds_per_log_increase * log(x$n_eggs / 8) +
    amh_log_odds_per_log_increase * log(x$amh / 2.5) +
    day1_log_odds_per_log_increase * log1p(x$n_day1) +
    day3_log_odds_per_log_increase * log1p(x$n_day3) +
    day5_log_odds_per_log_increase * log1p(x$n_day5)

  plogis(log_odds)
}

default_funs[["do_pgt_prob"]] <- f_do_pgt_prob1
```

## Simulation using the updated PGT-A mechanism

```{r}
set.seed(123)

patients <- simulate_patients(n)

embryos <- patients |>
  simulate_eggs() |>
  simulate_fert() |>
  simulate_day3() |>
  simulate_day5()

embryos_tested <- embryos |>
  simulate_pgt(
    pgt_specificity = PGT_SPEC,
    pgt_sensitivity = PGT_SENS
  )

transfers <- embryos_tested |>
  select_order_embryos() |>
  simulate_transfers()
```

## First-transfer analysis dataset

The analysis is restricted to patients with at least one day-5 embryo. The outcome is live birth following the first transfer.

```{r}
study_et1 <- merge(
  unique(
    embryos_tested[
      day5 == 1,
      .(patient_id, age, amh, n_eggs, n_day1, n_day3, n_day5, do_pgt)
    ]
  ),
  transfers[
    transfer_number == 1,
    .(patient_id, transfer_number,outcome)
  ],
  by = "patient_id",
  all.x = TRUE
)

study_et1[, lb := fifelse(outcome == "live_birth",1,0,0)]
study_et1[, et := fifelse(!is.na(transfer_number),1,0)]
study_et1[, pgt_group := fifelse(do_pgt == 1,"pgt","no_pgt")]
```

```{r}
number_summary <- function(x, dig = 1, ...) {
    c(`Med [IQR]` = mediqr(x, dig = dig, ...), 
      `Mean (std)` = meansd(x, dig = dig, ...))
}
crosstable(study_et1,
  cols=c("age","amh","n_eggs","n_day1","n_day3","n_day5","et","lb"),
  percent_pattern = "{n} ({p_col})",
  funs = c(` ` = number_summary),
  by=pgt_group)
```

```{r}
crosstable(study_et1,
  cols=c("age","amh","n_eggs","n_day1","n_day3","n_day5","et","lb"),

```

## Propensity-score model and IPTW

```{r}
ps_formula <- do_pgt ~ age + amh + n_eggs + n_day1 + n_day3 + n_day5

ps_glm <- glm(ps_formula, data = study_et1, family = binomial())
summary(ps_glm)

w_ate <- weightit(
  formula = ps_formula,
  data = study_et1,
  method = "glm",
  estimand = "ATE"
)

study_et1[, ps := w_ate$ps]
study_et1[, iptw := w_ate$weights]
```

## Propensity-score and weight diagnostics

### Propensity-score distributions

```{r}
p_ps <- ggplot(study_et1, aes(x = ps, fill = pgt_group)) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.4) +
  scale_fill_npg(labels = c("no_pgt" = "No PGT-A","pgt" = "PGT-A")) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 1)) +
  labs(x = "Propensity score", fill = "Group") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 16)
p_ps
```

### IPTW distributions

```{r}
iptw_plot_data <- study_et1[
  iptw <= quantile(iptw, 0.99, na.rm = TRUE)
]

p_w <- ggplot(iptw_plot_data, aes(x = iptw, fill = pgt_group)) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.4) +
    scale_fill_npg(labels = c("no_pgt" = "No PGT-A","pgt" = "PGT-A")) +
  labs(x = "IPTW", fill = "Group") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 16)
p_w
```

```{r,fig.height=4,fig.width=10}
((p_ps + labs(title="(A)")) + 
  (p_w + labs(title="(B)"))) +
  plot_layout(guides = "collect")
```

## Covariate balance

```{r,fig.height=6,fig.width=10}
variable_labels <- data.frame(
  old = c("age", "amh", "n_eggs", "n_day1","n_day3", "n_day5", "prop.score"),
  new = c("Age", "AMH", "Num. eggs", "Num. day 1","Num. day 3", "Num. day 5", "Propensity score")
)

p_love_iptw <- love.plot(
  w_ate,
  stats = "mean.diffs",
  abs = TRUE,
  thresholds = c(m = 0.1),
  var.order = "unadjusted",
  line = FALSE,
  stars = "raw",
  var.names = variable_labels,
  size = 4,
  colors = c("grey40", "steelblue"),
  shapes = c(16, 17)
)

p_love_iptw +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 18) +
  scale_color_npg() +
  labs(
    title = "Covariate balance before and after IPTW",
    x = "Absolute standardised mean difference"
  )

summary(w_ate)
```

## IPTW outcome estimates

### Weighted live-birth risks

IPTW group live birth rate per patient

```{r}
weighted_risks <- study_et1[, .(
  live_birth_risk = weighted.mean(lb, iptw)
), by = do_pgt]

weighted_risks
```

## Survey-weighted inference and confidence intervals

Risk ratio (via log link binomial GLM)

```{r}
design_iptw <- svydesign(
  ids = ~1,
  weights = ~iptw,
  data = study_et1
)

fit_svy <- svyglm(
  lb ~ do_pgt,
  design = design_iptw,
  family = quasibinomial(link = "log")
)

summary(fit_svy)

rr_ci <- exp(cbind(
  estimate = coef(fit_svy),
  confint(fit_svy)
))

rr_ci
```

Risk difference (via identity link binomial GLM)

```{r}
fit_svy <- svyglm(
  lb ~ do_pgt,
  design = design_iptw,
  family = quasibinomial(link = "identity")
)

summary(fit_svy)

diff_ci <- cbind(
  estimate = coef(fit_svy),
  confint(fit_svy)
)

diff_ci
```
